lines.en: label mikudorm45:
I knock on Miku’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Miku 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: It’s the first instance of me coming here to spend time with her since the Christmas party, and while I should be of the mindset that maybe things might go somewhere this time-
lines.zh: 这是圣诞派对之后我第一次来这儿陪她，按理说我该抱着“这次说不定能有点进展”的心态——

lines.en: I can’t help but worry that Makoto might somehow get involved again.
lines.zh: 可我忍不住担心 Makoto 会不会又掺和进来。

lines.en: I was able to miraculously survive one topless Miku run-in with her (Albeit with a surprisingly painful slap) but I really don’t know if I’d be able to emerge from a second alive.
lines.zh: 上一次跟赤裸上身的 Miku 被她撞见（虽然挨了一巴掌，疼得出乎意料），我已经奇迹般地活了下来，可我真不知道第二次还能不能活着走出去。

lines.en: Considering that I haven’t heard anything from Makoto yet, though, I doubt that Miku has told her anything.
lines.zh: 不过考虑到我至今没从 Makoto 那儿听到任何风声，我猜 Miku 应该什么都没跟她说。

lines.en: Which is good, because I have no idea how I’d react if I were to be suddenly confronted by the two of them at once regarding our respective relationships.
lines.zh: 这倒是好事，因为我完全想象不出，要是她们俩因为我跟各自的关系突然一起找上门来，我会是什么反应。

lines.en: Oh no.
lines.zh: 糟了。

lines.en: : Ah! One more second, Sensei! I’m...not done gettin' ready yet!
lines.zh: : 啊！再等一下下，Sensei！我……还没准备好呢！

lines.en: : What exactly are you getting ready for, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你到底在准备什么啊，Miku？

lines.en: : I...can’t tell you that!
lines.zh: : 我……不能告诉你！

lines.en: : Well, that’s not suspicious at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这一点都不可疑。

lines.en: : Just...give me another minute! I made a mistake!
lines.zh: : 就……再给我一分钟！我搞砸了！

lines.en: : What kind of mistake would-
lines.zh: : 你搞砸了什么——

lines.en: : Just give me a friggin’ minute, okay?! Jeez!
lines.zh: : 就给我他妈一分钟，行不行？！天哪！

lines.en: You know, maybe I should just quietly back out of the hall and go find something else to do?
lines.zh: 要不我还是悄悄退出走廊，去找点别的事做？

lines.en: This is likely one of those times where my inner monologue mysteriously predicts what is going to happen next, and I’m not really in the mood for a confrontation right now.
lines.zh: 这大概又是那种“内心独白神秘地预言了接下来会发生什么”的时刻，而我现在实在没心情面对冲突。

lines.en: Or...ever, for that matter.
lines.zh: 或者……应该说，什么时候都没心情。

lines.en: Let alone one that potentially involves someone as good at slapping as Makoto.
lines.zh: 更别提这次可能还牵扯到 Makoto 那种扇耳光的行家。

lines.en: : Okay! You can come in now, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 好了！你可以进来了，Sensei！

lines.en: : Before I do, can you confirm whether or not Makoto is in there?
lines.zh: : 在我进去之前，你能确认一下 Makoto 在不在里面吗？

lines.en: : Makoto? No, she’s at work right now.
lines.zh: : Makoto？不在，她现在在上班。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: I guess...Miku wasn’t getting ready for an intervention then?
lines.zh: 这么说……Miku 刚才准备的不是什么“干预谈话”？

lines.en: What else would she be getting ready for, though?
lines.zh: 可她还能在准备什么呢？

lines.en: scene black
I open the door to greet Miku and-
lines.zh: 我推开门去跟 Miku 打招呼，然后——

lines.en: scene intervention1
: Why don’t you take a seat, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你先坐下吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : You know, I was really hoping I wouldn’t ever have to hear those words.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我真希望这辈子都不会听到这句话。

lines.en: : Also, Makoto is here after all. Surprise.
lines.zh: : 另外，Makoto 到底还是在这儿。惊喜吧。

lines.en: : You fucking liar.
lines.zh: : 你这个该死的骗子。

lines.en: : We’re here precisely because Miku isn’t a liar, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我们之所以在这儿，恰恰是因为 Miku 不是骗子，Sensei。

lines.en: : Or rather- that she’d prefer to not keep things hidden from her best friend, despite how desperately you may want her to.
lines.zh: : 或者说——她更愿意对最好的朋友坦诚，哪怕你再怎么希望她瞒着。

lines.en: : Why is it okay to lie to me and not to you? That doesn’t seem fair at all.
lines.zh: : 为什么骗我可以，骗你就不行？这怎么想都不公平吧。

lines.en: scene intervention2
: Oh, fantastic! Since we’re now on topic of what constitutes “fair,” how about you-
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了！既然我们现在聊到了什么叫“公平”，那要不你——

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳咳。

lines.en: : I believe I told Sensei to take a seat, Makoto. ‘Yer gonna ruin the innervention.
lines.zh: : 我记得我是让 Sensei 坐下，Makoto。你这样会把这场“干谈会”给搅黄的。

lines.en: scene intervention3
: Ugh. Fine. Sensei, please sit down so we can proceed with this intervention.
lines.zh: : 呃。好吧。Sensei，请坐吧，好让我们把这场谈话继续下去。

lines.en: : I really don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 我真的不想坐。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta, Sensei. You’ve got two ladies wrapped around ‘yer finger and the time’s come to untangle ‘em.
lines.zh: : 你得坐，Sensei。有两位女士被你玩得团团转，现在是时候把她们理顺了。

lines.en: : There are a lot more than just two, Miku. Frankly, there are so many at this point that I doubt Sensei will ever be able to untangle all of them.
lines.zh: : 可不止两位，Miku。说实话，到了这个地步已经多得数不清，我怀疑 Sensei 这辈子都理不顺了。

lines.en: : Yeah, thanks for the reminder.
lines.zh: : 是啊，多谢提醒。

lines.en: scene black
I take a seat in a third chair that Miku and Makoto set up on the side of the room and wonder why they went to the trouble of doing that instead of just letting me sit on the couch.
lines.zh: 我在 Miku 和 Makoto 摆在房间一侧的第三把椅子上坐下，心里纳闷她们干嘛非要费这个事，直接让我坐沙发不就好了。

lines.en: But I guess comfort is probably the least of their concerns right now, when-
lines.zh: 不过我想，眼下她们最不在乎的大概就是我舒不舒服了，就在——

lines.en: : Oh, no. Don’t go getting lost in thought right now, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 哦，不。现在可别走神啊，Sensei……

lines.en: scene intervention4
: I should have just stayed at home.
lines.zh: : 我还不如待在家里算了。

lines.en: : This was gonna happen whether ya liked it or not, Sensei. It’s the only way we can settle matters once and for all.
lines.zh: : 不管你愿不愿意，这事都躲不掉，Sensei。这是我们把事情一次性了结的唯一办法。

lines.en: : Fine. Then I pick Makoto since at least she doesn’t lie to me. Meeting adjourned.
lines.zh: : 行。那我选 Makoto，至少她不骗我。散会。

lines.en: scene intervention5
if day > 5:
: Excellent. See you in school on Monday, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那周一学校见，Sensei。

lines.en: else:
: Excellent. See you in school tomorrow, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那明天学校见，Sensei。

lines.en: : Wait, no! The choice ain’t supposed to be as easy as that! In fact, there ain’t supposed to be a choice at all! Neither one of us expects ya to just-
lines.zh: : 等等，不对！选择哪有这么容易！事实上，根本就不该有什么选择！我们谁都没指望你就这么——

lines.en: : Sensei’s clearly made his decision already, Miku. I believe the only thing left for us to do is accept it.
lines.zh: : Sensei 显然已经做出决定了，Miku。我觉得我们剩下的唯一能做的就是接受。

lines.en: scene intervention6
: Well...yeah. I guess that would be the easiest thing to do. Definitely a heck of a lot easier for me. But I kinda figured we were gonna at least talk about it a little.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。那大概是最省事的做法。对我来说肯定省事多了。不过我还以为我们至少会稍微聊一聊。

lines.en: : I ain’t ever liked somebody before, and I don’t want all these weird feelings cloggin’ up my brain when it’s already givin’ Usain Bolt a run for his money.
lines.zh: : 我以前从没喜欢过谁，我可不想让这些奇怪的感觉把我的脑子堵住——它本来就转得跟尤塞恩·博尔特有得一拼。

lines.en: : I know, I know. I was only being half serious. I’m just...not sure how to do this, though. Organizing an intervention for a love triangle is not exactly “normal.”
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。我刚才只是半开玩笑。我只是……不知道该怎么弄。为一段三角恋组织一场干预谈话，怎么都不算“正常”吧。

lines.en: : You know an organized meeting is bad when even Makoto isn’t into it.
lines.zh: : 连 Makoto 都提不起劲，你就知道这场会有多糟了。

lines.en: scene intervention7
: I’m doin’ my best, okay?!
lines.zh: : 我已经尽力了，好不好？！

lines.en: : Let’s just...let Miku take charge of this. She’s proven to be quite effective at making the first move as of late.
lines.zh: : 我们……还是让 Miku 来主导吧。最近她在“先发制人”这件事上可是相当有效。

lines.en: scene intervention8
: You seem less mad at me than I expected you to be.
lines.zh: : 你看起来没我想的那么生气。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t get me wrong. I want to be angrier with you. I just know that, in this case, Miku was the one who pounced on you.
lines.zh: : 哦，别误会。我倒想对你更生气一点。只是我知道，这次是 Miku 先扑上去的。

lines.en: : All you did was buy her a present she really liked.
lines.zh: : 你不过是给她买了件她很喜欢的礼物。

lines.en: : Granted, I’m sure there was much more that happened beforehand that ultimately culminated in this all happening, but the fault isn’t yours alone.
lines.zh: : 当然，我敢肯定之前还发生过很多别的事，才最终导致了今天这一切，但这不全是你的错。

lines.en: : Miku’s obviously had feelings for you for quite some time. Obviously not as long as I have, but it’s not as if we can ignore those feelings when they’re just as real as anyone else’s.
lines.zh: : Miku 显然已经喜欢你很久了。当然没有我喜欢得久，可既然这份感情跟别人的一样真实，我们总不能装看不见。

lines.en: : So much for letting Miku take charge of the meeting.
lines.zh: : 说好的让 Miku 主导这场会呢。

lines.en: scene intervention9
: I can’t believe you kissed her before me!
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你先吻了她，才轮到我！

lines.en: : Didn’t ya just admit I was the one who kissed him, Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto，你刚才不是承认了是我先吻他的吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but still!
lines.zh: : 是没错，但还是！

lines.en: : Do you want me to kiss you right now and even the playing field?
lines.zh: : 那你想让我现在就吻你，把局面拉平吗？

lines.en: scene intervention10
: Yes, actually. I would very much appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 是的，真的。我会非常感激。

lines.en: : Wait, wait, wait! Hold on a sec! Nobody’s kissin’ anyone!
lines.zh: : 等等等等等等！先等一下！谁都不许吻谁！

lines.en: : Maybe not right now. But who knows what the fuck you two would do if I were to leave the room.
lines.zh: : 也许现在不会。可我要是一离开这房间，天知道你们俩会干出什么来。

lines.en: : Just cause I kinda attacked Sensei doesn’t mean I think I’m at the front of the race or anythin’ like that!
lines.zh: : 就算我算是“袭击”了 Sensei，也不代表我觉得自己跑在最前面什么的！

lines.en: : I just didn’t want us keepin’ secrets from each other anymore! ‘Specially if I’ve got the green light to go ahead and try and make sense of all these butterflies!
lines.zh: : 我只是不想我们再对彼此藏着掖着了！特别是既然我已经拿到绿灯，可以试着去弄明白这些小鹿乱撞到底是什么了！

lines.en: : Green light? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 绿灯？你在说什么？

lines.en: scene intervention11
: Did you really think I was going to stop Miku from following her heart just because it’s trailing my own?
lines.zh: : 你真以为我会因为 Miku 的心跟在我的后面，就拦着她不让她追随吗？

lines.en: : I’ll admit that I was hoping things would never come to this but, now that they have, what else are we supposed to do other than simply deal with them?
lines.zh: : 我承认，我曾希望事情永远别走到这一步；可既然走到了，除了去面对，我们还能怎么办？

lines.en: : Frankly, I’m more comfortable with the idea of you romantically pursuing Miku than any of the other girls.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，比起其他任何一个女孩，我更能接受你去追 Miku。

lines.en: : Not that I’d ever expect you to romantically pursue anyone when romance is the furthest thing from your mind...but still.
lines.zh: : 当然，我也不指望你会去浪漫地追求谁——毕竟浪漫是你脑子里最不沾边的东西……但话是这么说。

lines.en: : So what, then? I’m free to just mess around with both of you? Because if that’s the case, this meeting could have been solved with a single text message.
lines.zh: : 那然后呢？我可以随便跟你们俩乱来？如果是这样，这场会一条短信就解决了。

lines.en: scene intervention12
: Sensei...you know we’re not just tryin’ to “mess around,” right? Me and Makoto actually like like you.
lines.zh: : Sensei……你知道我们不是只想“乱来”吧？我和 Makoto 是真的喜欢喜欢你。

lines.en: : Makoto and I.
lines.zh: : 是 Makoto 和我。

lines.en: : What am I supposed to do about that, though?
lines.zh: : 可这让我该怎么办？

lines.en: : I don’t know...maybe just...consider it when we’re all doin’ stuff together?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……也许就……在我们一起做什么的时候稍微考虑一下？

lines.en: : The whole reason I wanted to do somethin’ like this is so we wouldn’t hurt each other’s feelings in the long run.
lines.zh: : 我想做这种事，就是为了我们从长远来看不会伤到彼此的感情。

lines.en: : Both of you guys are crazy important to me, and I don’t wanna risk hidin’ anything if I think it could make stuff worse.
lines.zh: : 你们俩对我来说都重要得要命，要是觉得藏着会让事情更糟，我可不想冒这个险。

lines.en: That’s a surprisingly mature outlook from one of the least mature girls I know.
lines.zh: 这话从我所认识的最不成熟的女孩之一嘴里说出来，倒是成熟得令人意外。

lines.en: But it’s...respectable in its own twisted sort of way.
lines.zh: 不过……以一种扭曲的方式来说，倒也值得尊重。

lines.en: How much exactly does Miku intend to share, though? Because there’s certainly one thing I can think of that I can’t really imagine Makoto just brushing off.
lines.zh: 可 Miku 到底打算交代到什么程度？我反正能想到一件事，实在想象不出 Makoto 会一笑而过。

lines.en: : I just feel like this is more of a thing for the two of you rather than me.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，这更像是你们俩之间的事，而不是我的。

lines.en: : If I’m not being forced to pick between you, I can’t imagine this meeting making any sort of impact on things to come.
lines.zh: : 如果没人逼我在你们之间做选择，我想象不出这场会对以后能有什么影响。

lines.en: scene intervention13
: It is mostly for just me and Makoto-
lines.zh: : 这主要还是我和 Makoto 之间的事——

lines.en: : Makoto and me, in this case.
lines.zh: : 这种情况应该说“Makoto 和我”。

lines.en: : But you are Makoto.
lines.zh: : 可你不就是 Makoto 吗。

lines.en: : Oh, I get it.
lines.zh: : 哦，我懂了。

lines.en: : But yeah. It is mostly for us two, I guess. I just think that if everybody’s gonna be involved in this weird triangle thingy...that we should all know about it.
lines.zh: : 不过是啊。我想主要还是我们俩的事。我只是觉得，既然大家都要卷进这个奇怪的三角什么的……那我们就都该知道。

lines.en: : And that even if none of us are tryin’ to hold the other ones back...that we’re okay with whatever happens.
lines.zh: : 还有，就算我们谁都没想拖谁后腿……我们对发生什么都无所谓。

lines.en: : Are you really okay with whatever happens, though, Miku?
lines.zh: : 可你真的对发生什么都无所谓吗，Miku？

lines.en: scene intervention14
: Whaddya mean?...
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？……

lines.en: : Like if you decide to just go full-Makoto and ignore how I feel? Course I wouldn’t be okay with it...so maybe that ain’t the best word.
lines.zh: : 比如你决定彻底倒向 Makoto 那边，完全不管我的感受？那我当然做不到无所谓……所以也许这个词不太合适。

lines.en: : I’d understand, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我会理解的。

lines.en: : I don’t really know how you make decisions and stuff, Sensei, but if I were in your shoes, I’d be tryin’ to hurt the least amount’a people possible.
lines.zh: : 我不太清楚你是怎么做决定的，Sensei，不过换作是我，我会尽量少伤人。

lines.en: : One of us is obviously gonna get hurt. Maybe even all three. But I feel like just knowin’ that is enough to make it all hurt a little less.
lines.zh: : 我们当中肯定有人会受伤。说不定三个都会。可我觉得，光是知道这一点，就足够让一切没那么疼了。

lines.en: : I want to give you a hug, but I hardly think this is the right time.
lines.zh: : 我想抱抱你，但我觉得现在实在不是时候。

lines.en: scene intervention15
: Huggin’ your rival’s just as good as admitting defeat! We can hug when all of this is said and done.
lines.zh: : 抱你的情敌就等于认输！等这一切尘埃落定我们再抱。

lines.en: : If things are ever said and done. Sensei here is so helpless when it comes to making decisions that, more often than not, I find myself making them for him.
lines.zh: : 如果能尘埃落定的话。这位 Sensei 做起决定来实在太没用了，结果多半都是我替他做。

lines.en: : Can you do me a favor and decide that this meeting is over, then? Because if nobody has any questions-
lines.zh: : 那你能不能帮个忙，决定这场会到此结束？因为要是没人有问题的话——

lines.en: scene intervention16
: Oh, I’ve got a question. How come ya ain’t kissed my roommate yet?
lines.zh: : 哦，我有个问题。你怎么还没吻过我室友？

lines.en: : I don’t like the bluntness with which that question was asked, but I definitely would like to know the answer to that as well.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这问题问得这么直白，不过我也确实很想知道答案。

lines.en: : Just hasn’t come up yet.
lines.zh: : 只是还没轮到而已。

lines.en: : But, like...
lines.zh: : 可是，那个……

lines.en: scene intervention17
: Ain’t you two already doin’ more...adult stuff?
lines.zh: : 你们俩不是已经在做更……大人的事了吗？

lines.en: : You know, I kind of assumed that when you said you two share everything that you didn’t literally mean everything.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我还以为你们说“什么都一起分享”的时候，不是字面意义上的“什么”。

lines.en: : Isn’t...goin’ straight to the major stuff like that kinda like cheating?
lines.zh: : 直接就跳到那种“主菜”，是不是有点像作弊？

lines.en: : Is this something we really have to discuss right now?
lines.zh: : 这事我们非得现在讨论吗？

lines.en: : Does it have somethin’ to do with how Makoto’s always surrounded by those videos? You like...doin’ her a favor to prevent her from goin’ crazy or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 是不是跟 Makoto 身边总围着那些视频有关？你是……帮她个忙，免得她憋疯了之类的？

lines.en: scene intervention18
: Obviously n-
lines.zh: : 当然不——

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene intervention19
: That is absolutely not why we have been doing those things!
lines.zh: : 我们做那些事绝对不是因为那个原因！

lines.en: : So if you ever find yourself going crazy as well, Miku-
lines.zh: : 所以万一哪天你也憋疯了，Miku——

lines.en: scene intervention20
: Don’t listen to him. This is how he traps you into a relationship where he doesn’t have to kiss you because you’ve already skipped that step.
lines.zh: : 别听他的。他就是这么把人套进一段关系里的——你已经跳过了那一步，他就不用吻你了。

lines.en: : Run while you still can. Don’t turn into another me.
lines.zh: : 趁还能跑就赶紧跑。别变成第二个我。

lines.en: : Two Makotos does sound like a little too much now that ya mention it...
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，两个 Makoto 听起来确实有点太多了……

lines.en: : Why don’t ya just kiss him yourself, though? It ain’t that hard. Ya just kinda...go for it.
lines.zh: : 那你干嘛不自己吻他呢？又没那么难。你就……直接上呗。

lines.en: : Yeah, Makoto. This is all your fault and you should try and be more like Miku.
lines.zh: : 就是啊，Makoto。这全是你的错，你该学着像 Miku 一点。

lines.en: scene intervention21
: Maybe you should try and be more like Miku! I have done more than enough for you and deserve a reward every once in a while!
lines.zh: : 也许你才该学着像 Miku 一点！我为你做的早就够多了，偶尔也该得到点奖励吧！

lines.en: : She does deserve it, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 她确实该得到，Sensei。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong, but...aren’t you supposed to be rooting for yourself right now?
lines.zh: : 要是我说错了请纠正我，不过……你现在不是该为自己加油吗？

lines.en: : I figured the whole “Team Makoto” thing would be over with after today and that you’d try a little harder to keep me to yourself.
lines.zh: : 我还以为今天之后“Makoto 队”那套就该结束了，你总该稍微努力一点把我占为己有吧。

lines.en: scene intervention22
: Why would I try and keep ya to myself when Makoto likes you too? That ain’t fair at all.
lines.zh: : Makoto 也喜欢你，我干嘛要把你占为己有？那太不公平了。

lines.en: : I don’t see any reason why I can’t stay on Team Makoto and like you. There some kinda rule against that?
lines.zh: : 我看不出为什么我不能一边待在“Makoto 队”，一边喜欢你。这有什么规矩不许吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t think there’s a rulebook we can consult...but that’s not normally how love triangles go...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我觉得也没什么规则手册可以查……不过三角恋通常不是这么演的……

lines.en: scene intervention23
: Well, maybe it ain’t really a triangle then?
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许它根本就不是什么三角？

lines.en: : Aren’t you kinda rootin’ for me too, Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto，你不是也有点为我加油吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Not really?
lines.zh: : 算不上吧？

lines.en: : I obviously don’t want to hold you back from pursuing the person you admire, but if you’re asking if I’m hoping you and Sensei get closer...absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 我当然不想拦着你去追你仰慕的人，不过你要问我是不是希望你和 Sensei 走得更近……绝对不是。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Huh.
scene intervention24
: Guess I’m the weird one, then.
lines.zh: : 那看来奇怪的是我了。

lines.en: : No surprise there.
lines.zh: : 这倒是一点都不意外。

lines.en: : Do you have any questions, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你有什么问题吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Just one. Was this really necessary?
lines.zh: : 只有一个。这真的有必要吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. But I’m sure it made Miku feel a little more comfortable and, strangely enough, I think I feel that way as well.
lines.zh: : 大概没必要。但我敢肯定这让 Miku 舒服了一点，而且说来奇怪，我觉得自己也一样。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t. This was weird and I’d prefer that we don’t ever do anything like this again in the future.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可没觉得。这太怪了，我希望以后永远别再来一次。

lines.en: : If you honestly think you’ll be able to avoid a similar conflict in the future, you’re out of your mind.
lines.zh: : 如果你真的以为以后能避开类似的冲突，那你就是疯了。

lines.en: : It’s only a matter of time until you’re having this exact conversation with every pair of friends who fall hopelessly in love or...like with you.
lines.zh: : 迟早有一天，你会跟每一对无可救药地爱上你、或者……喜欢上你的朋友，重复这场一模一样的对话。

lines.en: : All things considered, I think Miku and me handled this extremely well.
lines.zh: : 总的来看，我觉得我和 Miku 处理得相当好。

lines.en: : Miku and I.
lines.zh: : 是“Miku 和我”。

lines.en: scene intervention25
: I changed my mind. You can have him.
lines.zh: : 我改主意了。他归你了。

lines.en: scene black
The intervention comes to a close as Makoto needs to start getting ready for work.
lines.zh: 这场干预谈话就此结束，因为 Makoto 得开始准备去上班了。

lines.en: It definitely feels a little later than normal for her to start heading over there, so I initially dismiss it as an excuse to give Miku and me some time alone.
lines.zh: 她出发的时间明显比平时晚了些，所以我一开始只当这是她给 Miku 和我留出独处时间的借口。

lines.en: But that notion is immediately quelled when Makoto says this.
lines.zh: 但这个念头在 Makoto 说出下面这句话时立刻被打消了。

lines.en: : Oh, and you two are going to be walking there with me. I refuse to leave this room knowing that her shirt would immediately come off as soon as the door closes.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，你们俩要陪我一起走过去。我可不愿意一走出这个房间就知道，门一关她的上衣就会立刻被脱掉。

lines.en: : That happened one time!
lines.zh: : 那才发生过一次！

lines.en: : I do kinda wanna walk, though. So I’ll come.
lines.zh: : 不过我还真有点想走走。所以我去。

lines.en: : And you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Ugh, fine.
lines.zh: : 呃，行吧。

lines.en: scene intervention26
: Oh, for fuck’s sake! Who keeps turning the number on our door upside down?! It’s getting very tiring!
lines.zh: : 哦，真是够了！到底是谁老把我们门牌号倒过来？！烦死人了！

lines.en: : Do you really think it’s weird that I wanna be on Team Makoto and Team Miku? Cause I just don’t really get why.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我想同时待在“Makoto 队”和“Miku 队”很奇怪吗？因为我实在不明白为什么。

lines.en: : That’s something you’ll have to talk to Makoto about. I’m perfectly fine with it.
lines.zh: : 这个你得去问 Makoto。我完全没意见。

lines.en: : I do stand to benefit the most, though, so I’m probably biased.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实是获利最大的那个，所以大概有偏见吧。

lines.en: scene intervention27
: Why are we talking about that again?! The intervention is over and it’s time to return to reality!
lines.zh: : 我们干嘛又聊回这个了？！干预谈话已经结束了，该回到现实了！

lines.en: : Oh, and sorry for lyin’ about Makoto not bein’ around. I figured ya would’ve ran if I told ya she was with me.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，对不起我骗你说 Makoto 不在。我要是告诉你她跟我在一起，你肯定掉头就跑。

lines.en: : It’s whatever. That honestly went a lot better than I was expecting.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。说实话比我想象的要好多了。

lines.en: : Yeah, nobody cried at all. And Makoto only got a tiny bit flustered when I brought up her relationship with “little” Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是啊，一个人都没哭。我提到她和“小”Sensei 的关系时，Makoto 也只慌了一小下。

lines.en: : Please don’t call it that, Miku.
lines.zh: : 别那么叫，Miku。

lines.en: : Please don’t talk about that at all! And definitely not in the halls!
lines.zh: : 根本别提那件事！尤其在走廊里绝对不行！

lines.en: scene black

lines.zh: Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！
